selection: Single leaf among FSD classes after removing ontology ancestors, CC0 WAVs. Per leaf order by SHA256 of Reel-reference-source-v1/ID (official train) or Reel-reference-eval-v1/ID (official eval). Keep at most one recording per uploader per leaf. Keep up to 9 in train, at least 3; up to 3 per leaf in eval. Calibration uploaders have SHA256(source-calibration-v1/UPLOADER)[0] modulo 3 equal to zero. Other eval uploaders form the holdout. No recording or uploader shared between train, calibration and holdout. Possible overlap with encoder pretraining is unknown.
protocol: Each query is only the first four seconds (or all if shorter), first channel of original recording. Search the fixed global text catalogue and real training clips, no candidate list supplied. Exact label required. Unknown includes no match, including inaudible or ambiguous cues. The withheld condition removes the true class from audio references, keeping all text alternatives. Raw text top1 always chooses a name. Calibration selected unique first-place agreement with minimum cosine .10 text / .25 recording, targeting >=85% positive precision and <=6% withheld false names. All rules frozen before holdout scoring.

holdout_candidate_comparison.protocol: Use unchanged Reel PlaybackSounds(AST) and EventHistory(YAMNet) on exactly the same first four seconds. A hit means the human leaf label appears in the union of returned names. Other cues, captions, and GPT reasoning are excluded from this comparison. Multiple names may be reported per clip.
